title: EE60051: Emc And Emi Control
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

EMI - Interference Problem Terminology. Typical noise path Application of
network theory - Methods of elimination.
Noise sources , Passive components, Capacities,
Inductors, Resistors,
Transformers active devices, Transistors, FETS, ICs - Intrinsic noise sources.
Noise Elimination - Shielding - E.S. shielding, EM shielding, Calculations
Shielded conductors.
Grounding and Bonding - Safety ground - Signal ground - Single point
grounding - Multipoint grounding - Hardware grounding - Grounding of
shields.
Additional Noise Reduction Techniques - Balancing - Power supply decoupling Isolation - Filters.
Shielding Effectiveness - Absorption - Reflection - Seams - Holes Gaskets.
Contact Protection - Inductive Loads - Resistive Loads.
Principles of Electromagnetic Compatibility.
